title: Club dues disallowance
reason: A receipt type and zero deduction are sufficient.

title: Qualified transportation fringe disallowance
reason: A qualified-fringe receipt classification is sufficient.

title: Annual per-recipient gift limitation
mandatory_modifiers: prior gifts to the same individual in the taxable year | §274(b)(1)(A)-(B) exclusions | §274(b)(2) aggregation rules
reason: Exact enforcement requires cumulative annual per-recipient state, not only the current receipt.

title: Foreign travel business-allocation limitation
reason: Requires derived trip-duration and business-use allocation attributes.

title: Substantiation requirement
mandatory_modifiers: amount | time/place or date/description | business purpose | business relationship | qualified nonpersonal use vehicle exception
reason: A derived substantiation predicate can represent the evidentiary requirements.

title: Convention outside North American area limitation
mandatory_modifiers: business relationship test | North American area definition | qualifying Caribbean-country treatment
reason: Requires derived location and business-purpose facts.

title: Cruise-ship convention limitation and annual cap
mandatory_modifiers: U.S.-registered vessel | qualifying ports | reporting requirements | $2,000 annual limitation
reason: The annual $2,000 cap requires state across multiple convention expenses.

title: Section 212 seminar and convention disallowance
reason: A receipt purpose/category predicate is sufficient.

title: Employee achievement award deduction limits
mandatory_modifiers: $400 nonqualified-plan annual limit | $1,600 qualified-plan annual limit | award definitions and special rules
reason: Exact annual award aggregation cannot be enforced from a single receipt alone.

title: Business-meal eligibility requirements
mandatory_modifiers: not lavish or extravagant | taxpayer/employee presence | §274(k)(2) exceptions
reason: Requires meal-quality, presence, and exception eligibility attributes.

title: Employer-provided commuting transportation disallowance
reason: The base category is simple; exactness requires a safety-necessity predicate.

title: Luxury water transportation limitation
reason: Requires a derived trip per-diem ceiling and exception classification.

title: Travel as a form of education disallowance
reason: Travel purpose is sufficient for the prohibition.

title: Spouse, dependent, or accompanying-person travel limitation
mandatory_modifiers: accompanying person is employee | bona fide business purpose | expense otherwise deductible by accompanying person
reason: Requires relationship, employment, and purpose predicates.

title: Meal deduction percentage limitation
reason: E.deduct can encode the percentage, but exactness requires exception and special-rate predicates.
